senses.en: (from potential of Hydrogen) the logarithm of the reciprocal of hydrogen-ion concentration in gram atoms per liter; provides a measure on a scale from 0 to 14 of the acidity or alkalinity of a solution (where 7 is neutral and greater than 7 is more basic and less than 7 is more acidic)
senses.zh: (来自氢的潜能值)每升克原子中氢离子浓度的对数;提供溶液酸度或碱度从0到14的尺度测量(其中7中性大于7更基本,7以下更酸性).
